caption:
Some places make you want to slow the whole trip down. The Faroe Islands are one of them. 🌿

Imagine winding roads between green cliffs, tiny turf-roofed villages, Atlantic weather rolling in and views you have to walk a little to earn.

These five places each offer a different side of the islands: the dramatic headlands of Kalsoy, the quiet valley at Saksun, the colourful village of Gjógv, Tjørnuvík's sweeping bay and the remarkable cliffs around Trælanípa.

Build in spare time for weather and ferries. Some popular hikes have access fees or restrictions, and farmland and village paths aren't public shortcuts — always check official local guidance before setting out.

Which stop would you explore first? Save these ideas for a slower island adventure. 🗺️

Photography: Marc Zimmer, Polina Kuzovkova, Annie Spratt, Himmel S & Sebastian Boring / Unsplash.
